description: Get the full record for one place, stage, pier or vessel on the Stockholm Archipelago Trail by identifier: description, photo (image.contentUrl with credit/license), opening hours, website/phone, accessibility, SAT passport info and links. Use this when the user asks about a specific place ("tell me more about Arholma handel") and you have its id (sat:poi:…, sat:section:…, sat:pier:…) from a map card, search or an earlier response. Same data as fetch. Do not use for searching by name (use search) or for trip planning (use day_trip/plan_route).

lang.description: Language of the user's message: 'sv' when the user writes in Swedish, otherwise 'en'. Always pass it — labels, dates and the card are rendered in this language.

name: place_details

metadata.description: Extra fields such as type, category, version, license, status.

text.description: The full record as serialized JSON-LD.
